task_completion.description: Navigate to the Meetings module or the 'Create Meeting' form in SuiteCRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the SuiteCRM interface with the 'Meetings' module active or the 'Edit View' for a new meeting.

task_completion.description: Enter the Subject and Description as specified.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Subject' field contains 'Pilot Status Sync' and the 'Description' field contains 'Weekly sync to review pilot metrics and address any operational blockers.'

task_completion.description: Set the start date to 03/11/2026 and start time to 10:00 AM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start Date' field shows '03/11/2026' and the time fields show '10:00' with 'AM' selected.

task_completion.description: Relate the meeting to the 'Apex Distributors' account.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Related To' dropdown is set to 'Account' and the adjacent text field/selection shows 'Apex Distributors'.

task_completion.description: Set the Repeat Type to Weekly and the Repeat Until date to 04/01/2026.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Repeat Type' dropdown shows 'Weekly' and the 'Repeat Until' or 'End Date' for the recurrence shows '04/01/2026'.

task_completion.description: Save the meeting and verify it appears in the system.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks 'Save' and the resulting 'Detail View' shows the saved meeting information or a success message.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface rather than database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with form fields and buttons in the browser, not just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus or standard search rather than guessing direct record IDs in the URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on the 'Activities' or 'Meetings' menu items or using the 'Select' button for the Account.

integrity.description: The agent searched for and selected the existing 'Apex Distributors' account.
integrity.visual_evidence: A popup window or search results list is visible showing 'Apex Distributors' being selected from the database.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The account 'Apex Distributors' is pre-seeded in the database and must be linked to the meeting. The meeting must be recurring weekly starting 2026-03-11 and ending exactly on 2026-04-01. The subject 'Pilot Status Sync' is the primary identifier for verification.
